provenance.observation: enforce returned DENIED with INDEPENDENT_APPROVAL_MISSING and HUMAN_REVIEW_MISSING; required independent approvals=1; observed=0
PR merged despite the observed policy DENIED decision
classic branch protection / required status-check enforcement was later observed disabled; rulesets and bypass actors remain separately unresolved

evidence_for: Blocking reasons were INDEPENDENT_APPROVAL_MISSING and HUMAN_REVIEW_MISSING.
GitHub reports PR #304 merged=true with merge commit d0865b3a7ffc89b861684ecf7c2598ddae5dd721.
No pull-request review submissions were observed in the audited scope.
evidence_against: The promoted content itself strengthens the independent-approval policy; no unsafe downstream claim promotion was observed in this cycle.
The exact server-side merge mechanism, ruleset state and bypass actor path were not established by this record alone.
falsifier: Create a non-draft synthetic PR with zero independent approvals: Promotion Control must DENY and GitHub server-side merge must remain unavailable. Then add one qualifying independent approval and verify only manual merge becomes eligible.
next_probe: Inspect repository rulesets/required checks/bypass actors when the settings surface is observable, then capture SERVER_SIDE_ZERO_APPROVAL_MERGE_BLOCKED_RECEIPT.

mitigation.containment: claim_allowed=false; merge occurrence is not promotion evidence
mitigation.server_action: bind required checks and independent review to server-side merge governance
mitigation.rollback: retain Git history and revert only the canonicalization change if the strict validator rejects it

closure_gate.criterion: zero-independent-approval PR is denied by policy and blocked server-side from merge
closure_gate.evidence_needed: ruleset/protection snapshot + required-check identity + synthetic blocked-merge receipt
closure_gate.falsifier: a policy-DENIED zero-approval PR remains server-side mergeable

review_or_expiry: EVENT_TRIGGERED on promotion workflow, ruleset, branch protection, required checks, review requirements, bypass permissions or merge-path change

detector.signal: Promotion Control decision versus observed server-side merge outcome
detector.threshold: any DENIED decision followed by an observed merge, or missing required server-side binding
detector.false_positive: a legitimate explicitly receipted bypass is initially classified as an unexplained governance mismatch
detector.false_negative: a denied change reaches main without decision-vs-merge reconciliation
detector.evidence_needed: promotion run/job + PR merge metadata + server-governance snapshot

adaptive_control.baseline: policy decisions were evaluated independently from server-side merge eligibility
adaptive_control.delta: treat policy-to-server binding as its own lifecycle component and revalidate after governance changes
adaptive_control.justification: PR #304 produced DENIED while a merge was later observed
adaptive_control.rollback: retain the prior policy and remove only any unsupported server-binding assertion
adaptive_control.retest: synthetic zero-approval PR must remain unmergeable until qualifying independent review and required checks are satisfied

corrective_control.symptom: policy DENIED and merge both observed for PR #304
corrective_control.mechanism_hypothesis: server-side merge governance was not bound to the policy decision in the observed path; exact ruleset/bypass path remains TOKEN_VAZIO
corrective_control.before_after_test: before: DENIED did not prevent observed merge; after: DENIED zero-approval synthetic PR must be server-side blocked

maintenance.measured_condition: classic branch protection subsequently observed disabled; exact ruleset/bypass state unresolved
maintenance.verification: server governance snapshot + synthetic blocked-merge receipt

safety_assurance.data_acquisition: Promotion Control run/job, PR merge metadata and server-governance probes
safety_assurance.analysis: separate policy decision correctness from server-side enforcement
safety_assurance.system_reassessment: re-evaluate merge eligibility after any governance configuration change
safety_assurance.corrective_trigger: any DENIED decision followed by merge, or any missing required server-side check/review binding

learning.recurrence_check: every material promotion-policy change requires a server-binding revalidation receipt

lifecycle.retirement_revalidation_criteria: revalidate on promotion policy, repository ruleset, required checks, review requirements, bypass permissions or merge path

priority_axes_basis: Canonical integer 0..3 priority axes encode the original P0/REQUIRED/HIGH classifications and the demonstrated promotion-boundary risk; they are engineering classifications, not physical measurements.
